MUV2.DE.thesis: Munich Re raised its 2026 profit target to EUR 6.6bn with Q3 results (9M net result EUR 5.7bn); the screen shows a rare leader in a weak tape: +4.2% 20d vs median -5.4%, 11.7% above SMA200, 2.5% off its 52w high, RSI 58.5, low 25.6% volatility. Rate-sensitive, non-tech earnings and EUR exposure suit a defensive regime; next results are not due until late February.
